body.heading: What this is
paragraphs: Myridia is a notebook, an idea-farm and a collection of small free-software experiments. Everything here is a plain document in a plain repository: no database, no build magic, no hidden strings.
The site is generated from the same JSON files you can read in the source tree. What you see is what is stored — one page, one document, one commit.

body.heading: How it works
paragraphs: Each document lives under content/myridia/docs/. Threads collect replies around a single idea, posts are longer pieces, pages are the standing text of the site — like this one.
The whole bag of content can be mirrored, forked and carried anywhere. It is built on free software, from the generator down.
